operations.scientific_task: Estimate Lisle joint foliation-lineation fabric from orthogonal measured pairs.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoStereonetAnalysis uses plane poles alone; Lisle fabric uses jointly observed lineations and planes, so different lineation fabrics remain distinguishable.
operations.numeric_oracle: Identical horizontal planes with north-directed in-plane lines give diag(2/3,1/3,0), independently from averages of dyads.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate the unique cylindrical-fold axis from the girdle of measured plane poles.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoStereonetAnalysis fits a dominant plane using its leading pole eigenvector. A cylindrical fold uses the least-eigenvalue girdle axis, a different geological inference.
operations.numeric_oracle: Poles +/-north and +/-east have moment diag(1/2,1/2,0); fold axis is vertical up to sign and eigenvalue gap is 1/2.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate a Fisher population mean and confidence cone for directed structural measurements.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing stereonet and plane-intersection tools have no directional population confidence calculation. Directed polarity is retained rather than folded to an axial hemisphere.
operations.numeric_oracle: Four directed vectors at +/-30 degrees from north have R/N=sqrt(3)/2. Fisher cone follows acos(1-(N-R)/R*(0.05^(-1/(N-1))-1)); kappa additionally obeys coth(k)-1/k=R/N.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate an antipodally invariant confidence ellipse for the major axis of an anisotropic fabric.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoStereonetAnalysis exposes a dominant fit but no axial confidence region. Fisher directional confidence is not antipodally invariant and assumes a different population.
operations.numeric_oracle: Axis multiplicities 6:3:1 yield eigenvalues .6,.3,.1. F(2,16) quantile has closed form 8*(.05^(-1/8)-1); insert in the independent Bingham semi-angle expression.

operations.scientific_task: Infer planar strain from measured elliptical markers using Rf/phi, with Robin log-tensor comparison.
operations.distinct_from_existing: No baseline operation estimates finite strain from elliptical grain/marker populations; pole stereonets cannot infer marker axial ratios.
operations.numeric_oracle: Identical ellipses with semiaxes 2 and 1 along the section axes have Rf/phi ratio 2 and Robin ratio 2, both at zero degrees.

operations.scientific_task: Derive fault-slip kinematic compression/extension bisector axes from measured plane and directed slip pairs.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoStructuralPlaneIntersection intersects two planes. This operation uses a measured slip direction and one fault plane to derive kinematic P/T axes, without stress inversion.
operations.numeric_oracle: A down normal and north slip have bisectors with north and down absolute components 1/sqrt(2), with P and T mutually orthogonal.

operations.scientific_task: Recover principal stretches, Hencky strains and Flinn shape from a measured finite deformation gradient.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Baseline structural operations address plane geometry, not finite deformation tensors or strain-ellipsoid shape.
operations.numeric_oracle: Isochoric diagonal stretch (2,1,1/2) yields tensor diag(4,1,1/4), stretches 2,1,1/2, log-strains +/-ln2 and Flinn k=1.

operations.scientific_task: Separate rigid rotation from finite material stretch in a structural deformation gradient.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Finite-strain eigenvalues describe stretching but do not recover rigid-body rotation. No baseline stereonet tool performs deformation polar decomposition.
operations.numeric_oracle: A 90-degree vertical-axis rotation times diag(2,1,1/2) has right stretch diag(2,1,1/2), left stretch diag(1,2,1/2), and rotation angle 90 degrees.

operations.scientific_task: Integrate a constant tectonic velocity gradient over an explicit duration using the upstream matrix exponential.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Static plane or finite-strain analysis does not integrate a time-dependent deformation mapping. This tool solves the constant-flow evolution task.
operations.numeric_oracle: Unit simple shear has L^2=0, hence exp(2L)=I+2L; F_xy=2 and determinant=1 independently of numerical exponentiation.

operations.scientific_task: Quantify noncoaxial deformation through strain rate, spin and the kinematic vorticity number.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Finite polar rotation is an accumulated mapping property; kinematic vorticity diagnoses instantaneous coaxial versus noncoaxial flow and is not a duplicate rotation calculation.
operations.numeric_oracle: Unit simple shear has symmetric and antisymmetric xy components 1/2, equal tensor norms, Wk=1 and curl magnitude 1/Myr.

operations.scientific_task: Resolve measured stress onto fracture planes, retaining normal compression, shear magnitude and physical traction.
operations.distinct_from_existing: No baseline tool projects a geological stress tensor onto fractures. This returns traction, whereas plane intersections return only geometric lines.
operations.numeric_oracle: For diag(100,60,20) MPa and a 45-degree north/down normal, resolved compression is (100+20)/2=60 MPa and shear is (100-20)/2=40 MPa.

operations.scientific_task: Assess frictional reactivation of closed fractures under declared pore pressure and Mohr-Coulomb parameters.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Traction alone contains no pore-pressure/friction failure criterion. This task explicitly evaluates closed-fracture reactivation, without elastic or seismic modeling.
operations.numeric_oracle: The 60 MPa normal/40 MPa shear fixture at 10 MPa pore pressure has effective normal 50, slip tendency .8, dilation .5, and Coulomb excess 40-.6*50=10 MPa.

operations.scientific_task: Express positive geochemical compositions as additive log ratios to an explicitly selected reference component.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoGeochemCLR uses the geometric mean and D redundant coordinates. ALR uses a declared analyte reference and D-1 coordinates with a distinct interpretive meaning.
operations.numeric_oracle: For [2,4,1] with third-component reference, coordinates are [ln2,ln4] and inverse closure gives [2/7,4/7,1/7].

operations.scientific_task: Map chemical compositions into explicitly defined orthonormal log-ratio balances for valid Euclidean analysis.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoGeochemCLR is rank-deficient in D-dimensional Euclidean space. ILR supplies a complete orthonormal D-1 basis, not an alias of CLR output.
operations.numeric_oracle: For [4,2,1] and the stated Helmert contrasts, balances are ln2/sqrt2 and 3ln2/sqrt6; reconstructed fractions are 4/7,2/7,1/7.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate the Aitchison center of a population of positive geological compositions.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoGeochemCLR transforms individual rows; it does not estimate a sample population center in the simplex.
operations.numeric_oracle: Geometric component means of [1,4] and [4,1] are both 2; closure gives [.5,.5], unlike an absolute concentration estimate.

operations.scientific_task: Represent closed mineral-chemical compositions as positive-orthant spherical angles and reconstruct their fractions.
operations.distinct_from_existing: This square-root simplex/sphere representation is neither CLR/ALR/ILR log-ratio geometry nor the existing stereonet mapping of geological directions.
operations.numeric_oracle: Closure of [1,1,2] gives [1/4,1/4,1/2]; square-root coordinates [.5,.5,1/sqrt2] yield both upstream ordered angles pi/4.

operations.scientific_task: Fit supplied chemical compositions to an explicit independent mineral endmember mass-fraction model.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoSpectralLinearUnmix fits unconstrained reflectance coefficients. This fits nonnegative closed chemical mass-fraction endmembers, with different physical inputs and constraints.
operations.numeric_oracle: Two orthogonal closed endmembers make the uniquely feasible mixture of [.25,.75] exactly [.25,.75]; this is an analytic mass-balance oracle, not a second optimizer.

operations.scientific_task: Calculate a CIPW normative mineral assemblage from explicitly supplied oxide and trace chemistry.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoGeochemOxideMoles converts oxide masses to moles; CIPW allocates those oxides to a normative assemblage through a mineralogical allocation scheme.
operations.numeric_oracle: A synthetic 100 wt-percent SiO2 composition with all other explicitly supplied entries zero has normative quartz=100 wt percent by stoichiometry.

operations.scientific_task: Compare classical, Cressie-Hawkins and Dowd empirical semivariograms on the same geological sample pairs.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoHPGLDirectionalSemivariogram computes a directional classical estimate. This single comparison tool diagnoses sensitivity to outliers using two robust estimators on identical isotropic pair bins; algorithms are not counted separately.
operations.numeric_oracle: For a concentration ramp of 2 ppm/m, lag differences are 2,4,6 and counts 3,2,1. Matheron is [2,8,18]; first Cressie bin is 2/(.457+.494/3+.045/9); first Dowd bin is 4.396.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate joint spatial/temporal geological semivariance from repeated fixed-station measurements, including both cross-time directions.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing HPGL directional variograms use a single-time spatial point set. This estimates a two-dimensional space-time lag surface from repeat monitoring.
operations.numeric_oracle: For z(x,t)=2x+3t, averaging forward/backward time pairs cancels cross terms, giving gamma(h,k)=(4h^2+9k^2)/2. First cell=6.5 ppm^2, opposite corner=58.5; first count=2*3*3=18.

operations.scientific_task: Fit correlated variance and correlation length to a supplied measured exponential semivariogram with fixed known nugget.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Neither the baseline empirical variogram nor prediction-grid kriging exposes an independent constrained fit to externally supplied empirical bins.
operations.numeric_oracle: Analytically constructed gamma(h)=.25+2*(1-exp(-h/3)) identifies variance=2 ppm^2, length=3 m and fixed nugget=.25 ppm^2; R squared=1.

operations.scientific_task: Regularize point covariance to two explicit finite discrete geological sampling supports.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing point kriging predicts at locations; this quantifies change of sampling support through covariance regularization, without producing kriging predictions or reserves.
operations.numeric_oracle: With C(h)=4exp(-h), averaging the four within-block covariances gives 2+2exp(-2); between nodes {0,2} and {1,3}, covariance is 3exp(-1)+exp(-3).

operations.scientific_task: Measure leave-one-out interpolation errors for a supplied fixed spherical geological variogram, retaining every validation fold.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoOrdinaryKrigingGrid generates prediction rasters. This tool removes each observation before prediction and measures held-out error; it does not duplicate a new grid/prediction API.
operations.numeric_oracle: Pure-nugget ordinary kriging gives equal weights to the three training points: predictions [3,8/3,7/3,2], errors [2,2/3,-2/3,-2], RMSE=sqrt(20/9).

operations.scientific_task: Measure multivariate chemical departure from a caller-declared background in nonredundant ILR coordinates.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoGeochemCLR transforms a composition but does not compare observations against an independently declared multivariate background. This emits a covariance-normalized anomaly score, not another transform.
operations.numeric_oracle: Background log ratios map to [-sqrt(3/2),0,sqrt(3/2)] with ML variance 1; the sample maps to ILR=2, so squared Mahalanobis distance=4.

operations.scientific_task: Parse and audit a local LAS drillhole log with explicit depth/curve units and preserved missing-value masks.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Baseline CSV record search and log/profile plotting do not parse LAS header/null conventions or enforce measured-depth integrity.
operations.numeric_oracle: Synthetic LAS depths [100,101,102] and assay [10,NULL,30] must yield row_count=3, valid_count=2, null_count=1 and unaltered positive values 10 and 30.

operations.scientific_task: Reconstruct a drillhole trajectory and normalized dogleg severity from a measured deviation survey.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing geographic distance/bearing tools do not integrate borehole deviation surveys or compute true vertical depth and dogleg severity.
operations.numeric_oracle: A 100-m circular arc from vertical to 60 degrees east has east=150/pi m, TVD=150sqrt(3)/pi m and dogleg severity 60/100*30=18 degrees/30m.

operations.scientific_task: Resample a measured drillhole log onto a declared regular depth basis using bounded linear interpolation.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoHoloViewsLineProfile only renders supplied data. This constructs an explicit numeric depth basis for aligning logs before cross-log analysis.
operations.numeric_oracle: For measured y=10+10z at depths 0,1,2 m, resampling at half-metre increments gives [10,15,20,25,30].

operations.scientific_task: Attenuate isolated drillhole-log spikes using an explicit median window and global standard-deviation threshold, retaining original values.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Baseline log visualization and general record cleaning do not apply a depth-indexed numerical spike filter with explicit thresholds and retained raw measurements.
operations.numeric_oracle: Values [10,10,30,10,10] have population standard deviation 8; the central rolling median is 10, so z=1 clips the central spike to 18 while all others remain 10.

operations.scientific_task: Segment a measured drillhole log at caller-specified value cutoffs and compute mean values within contiguous blocks.
operations.distinct_from_existing: This creates a contiguous-zone representation and within-zone log means, unlike profile rendering or isolated-spike filtering. It is not a count of selections or a generic threshold-only wrapper.
operations.numeric_oracle: At cutoff 20, contiguous classes are [0,0,1,1,0]. Block means are [12,12,27,27,10], retaining the last low block separately from the first.

operations.scientific_task: Intersect two measured interval logs in one drillhole to expose co-occurring geological units and their shared measured-depth support.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing spatial polygon overlays work in map coordinates. This intersects geological logs along one shared borehole measured-depth datum, retaining both lithology labels and interval support.
operations.numeric_oracle: Measured-depth intervals [0,10] and [4,8] intersect at [4,8], giving thickness and total shared support exactly 4 m.
